Folks — quick internal note based on procurement rules for Nova Health:

- If Nova purchases via AWS Private Offer, the marketplace charge will be billed as a consolidated AWS invoice. AWS supports private-offer term lengths up to 24 months, but we need to set the commitment allocation months correctly so their finance team can amortize the charge.
- For your ask (18 months starting 2027-05-01) we recommend: commit = 1.1M token-units/month; total committed units = 1.1M * 18 = 19.8M units.
- Invoice model options:
  * Option A (Marketplace PO): Single PO mapped to AWS Private Offer; AWS will bill per their cadence (we can request quarterly). Requires marketplace mapping spreadsheet (attached).
  * Option B (Redwood direct with staggered invoices): Redwood issues 4 invoices per year per your requested dates; we can produce an invoice schedule and attach it to the PO as Exhibit A.

Operational note: Option A is simpler for procurement (consolidated vendor) but can cause timing differences in recognition. Option B gives Nova direct line items on our invoices and allows us to apply the promotional credit we discussed (5% credit for signing by 2027-03-18).

Attaching: aws_private_offer_mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet stub) — this maps the PO line items to AWS SKU/offer IDs.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
